It's the day of the Gamma Fair, but Sarah doesn't want to go. Bundy rescues Kappa Psi Psi's bachelorette auction but pays for it later.

title: New Dogs, Old Tricks
description:
S01 E10 — The Pink Elephant
Pete and Dee Dee have an announcement. Across campus, Sarah struggles with her new living situation.

title: Love on Harbor Island
description: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

title: I Think I Do
description: Planning your life is not as simple as planning a party. Three sisters who make a living planning other people's parties are forced to realize that no matter how hard they try they can't control their own lives.

title: A Friend's Obsession
description: A woman finally gets her life back on track after the death of her fiancé. However, an old colleague then befriends her with the intention of making her his own, and will go to any cost to do so.

title: WWJD What Would Jesus Do? The Journey Continues
description: A pastor tries to lead his ex-con brother to Christ as they renovate an old church. When the church is robbed at gunpoint, one of the brothers makes a sacrifice that leads the pastor, gunman and community to redemption.

title: One Last Dance
description: Travis, Chrissa and Max part ways after a dance sequence choreographed by their master Alex goes wrong. Years later, they are forced to reconcile to save the deceased Alex's company.

title: Amber's Story
description: When a young girl is kidnapped in Arlington, Texas, her family and the local community set out to find her. Based on the real-life case of Amber Hagerman, whose abduction was instrumental in the creation of America's AMBER Alert system to help find missing children.

title: Ring of Deception
description: A single mother's life is turned upside down when a con man moves to her neighbourhood. While she falls for him, a second woman is determined to kill him, and doesn't care who gets in her way.

title: The Love Club: Lauren
description: When Lauren and Peter are on the brink of divorce, the Love Club steps in to help them rediscover a love that was never really lost.

title: Running Away
description: A woman must come to terms with the dark secrets that made her daughter run away from home.

title: A Man for Every Month
description: To get a feature out for her company's Man for Every Month blog, an introverted writer has to go on a date with a different man every month.

title: His Secret Past
description: When her daughter is rescued from a deadly attack by a stranger, a famous novelist joins the police to investigate. They soon discover the saviour's hidden past.

title: Fatal Defense
description: A single mother signs up for self-defence classes from a handsome instructor. But he develops a frightening obsession with her and orchestrates an increasingly deadly array of tests to see if she has truly learned from his lessons.

title: Her Boyfriend's Secret
description: After believing she has found the guy of her dreams, home renovator Melissa Davis soon learns that her dream man has a dark secret.
